complexity.notes: A debug print with math.ceil is left inside the loop and should be removed; it also wastes work since the raw float division below it is sufficient for the comparison. Popping from the end works but iterating the sorted list in reverse with an index would be more idiomatic and avoids mutating the list.
complexity.summary: Sorts cars by position, then pops from the back (closest to target first) comparing each car's arrival time to the current lead fleet's; a car with a strictly smaller arrival time starts a new fleet, otherwise it merges into the fleet ahead. Sorting dominates the running time.
